title: betula alnoides var. cylindrostachya
intro: Betula alnoides var. cylindrostachya, commonly known as Chinese silver birch, is a variety of the Betula alnoides tree species native to China and other parts of Asia. It is used in traditional medicine to treat a range of health issues, with reported health benefits including the reduction of fever, relief from coughs and respiratory problems, and the improvement of digestive health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relieve inflammation, calm the nervous system, and promote diuresis. The bioactive constituents of Betula alnoides var. cylindrostachya include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
